items.title: Chris Mason: Budget needs to go some way towards delivering PM's promises
items.summary: Support on the cost of living, and in particular energy bills, as well as announcments on devolution will be central to John Healey's first Budget.

items.title: Minimum wage set to rise but 18-20 year-olds will not get bigger increase
items.summary: Chancellor John Healey will reveal the new pay rates in the Budget, and has also announced measures to help households with the cost of living.

items.title: Two in court over alleged Iran-linked plot at RAF Fairford
items.summary: Mohmed Abdulkarim and Nouman Essghir, both 24, appear at Westminster Magistrates' Court on Tuesday.

items.title: King acknowledges 'suffering of the past' as Caribbean tour begins
items.summary: The King is on a nine-day tour that will take him to three countries, including the Bahamas, Guyana and Antigua and Barbuda.

items.title: Men abused woman after her husband drugged and advertised her online, court told
items.summary: Four men stand trial after the woman's ex-husband has pleaded guilty to drugging and raping her.

items.title: Landline switchover could cut people off in emergency, minister warned
items.summary: Plans to switch to digital landlines by January could leave remote areas of the UK vulnerable, MPs say.

items.title: Ceasefire extended across Ukraine's Kherson region, officials say
items.summary: The truce was originally planned for the stranded residents of Oleshky, and Russia and Ukraine say no breaches have been reported.

items.title: Norway and Finland leaders hold rare call with Putin
items.summary: An end to the conflict in Ukraine "will not be achieved through silence," Finland's President Alexander Stubb said.
